title: Token Corridor Competitive Decision-Control Plane
mission: Define and prove an OSS-first, provider-neutral bounded-decision control plane (working name Token Corridor) inside the AgentSwitchboard software factory. Before inventing infrastructure, evaluate real open/self-hosted decision engines, routers, structured-output runtimes, durable workflow engines, agent runtimes, sandboxes, and eval/observability platforms against commercial comparators. Compile repository/runtime evidence into typed decision requests, choose the cheapest adequate open or commercial engine by measured policy, preserve calibrated uncertainty and authority provenance, and route execution without duplicating Prompt Kit, FirstMate, AgentSwitchboard execution adapters, or already-solved open-source infrastructure. This plan participates as the AgentSwitchboard companion to the canonical TokenCorridor convergence program (TokenCorridor is the destination product/repository; current three-repo split is migration topology).

proof.target: Durable OSS-first competitive architecture plan narrowing the open and managed decision/software-factory ecosystem into evidence-gated Token Corridor and AgentSwitchboard development.
proof.achieved: The initial Jev-centric research floor was found incomplete and corrected. Current plan now inventories open/self-hosted and managed alternatives across decision engines, model routing, structured generation, durability, sandbox/runtime, software-factory orchestration, and eval/observability; exact local runtime bakeoffs remain unproven. FrontierAgent is now source-pinned at ApodexAI/FrontierAgent@9e533db6f6c34d16037ee5ec964c479d0eb51cde and classified as an Apache-2.0 execution-runtime donor with explicit scheduler, authority, artifact, and integration boundaries.
proof.ceiling: This plan proves a source-backed open-vs-managed architecture and selection program only. It does not prove any candidate's performance on the user's factory corpus, production readiness on the user's hardware, Token Corridor runtime behavior, live AFK execution, or a standalone product/repository boundary. No FrontierAgent clone/fork runtime, smoke run, ASB adapter, or TokenCorridor execution tracer is proven by this planning update.
